_comment: TRANSFORM CONTROL for row 249. This battery is expected to exit 1 with exactly one valid ESCAPED mutant. It applies the same forking-census transform as M1 in row249_group_census_snapshot.json, but its only named catcher imports the already-collected module without calling the census or asserting its behavior. A CAUGHT result here would mean a parse, collection, or import failure was masquerading as behavioral evidence in the primary battery.
subject: transform-only control proving the forking census mutant imports without a behavioral assertion

mutants.label: CONTROL the forking ps census must ESCAPE an import-only spec
mutants.new:
result = subprocess.run(["ps", "-eo", "pgid=,pid=,stat="],
                            capture_output=True, text=True)
    rows = [line.split() for line in result.stdout.splitlines()
            if line.split()]
    return [row[1] for row in rows
            if row[0] == str(pgid) and not row[2].startswith("Z")]
